title: dot agent event v1 (an agent session's last state)
description: Written by `dot cli hook run` (plugins/cli/libexec/hook.sh) to $XDG_STATE_HOME/dot/agents/<agent>/<session>.json and sent as a datagram to $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/dot/agent-events.sock. Read by dot top and dot session. Metadata only: never the prompt, tool input or tool output.

agent.description: The roster id of the agent whose hook fired

state.description: running: working on a prompt; blocked: waiting for the user (a permission or a question); idle: done, waiting for a prompt; error: the turn failed; gone: the session ended

event.description: The hook event the state came from (UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop...)

cwd.description: The session's working directory, as the agent reported it; empty when it did not
